name: agent-performance
description: Agent skills for measuring how Claude Code agents perform, starting with what they cost

interface.shortDescription: See what Claude Code work costs, and why
interface.longDescription: Report what Claude Code sessions cost at API list prices, from session transcripts or OpenTelemetry logs: spend by model, project, skill, tool and token type, how concentrated it is in a few long turns, what another model would have cost, and which changes are most likely to reduce it. Reads token counts only, and stays on your machine.
defaultPrompt: What are my Claude Code sessions costing, and why?
Which of my skills and tools are the most expensive?
What would my usage cost on Opus 5.5?
